title: Invest in Our Youth
body: Expand access to sports, mentorship, and life skills programs that shape confident, capable leaders.

title: Strengthen Education & Opportunity
body: Create pathways for young people to succeed--whether in college, trades, or entrepreneurship.

title: Safer, Stronger Communities
body: Address root causes--not just symptoms--by investing in prevention, mentorship, and community support.

title: Supporting the Elderly
body: Protect and uplift our seniors by expanding access to care, resources, and programs that ensure they are treated with the dignity and respect they deserve.

title: More Mental Health Resources
body: Expand access to mental health services so families no longer have to send loved ones off-island for care. Our people deserve support close to home.

title: Better Business Opportunities
body: Create real pathways for local entrepreneurs and small businesses to grow, compete, and keep economic opportunities within our community.
